title: Design: Long and unusual names stay in their rows in the work order Bill To list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, that bills itself, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer C, in Estimate, that bills itself.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p2-03-after-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Type the first word of customer A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer C.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens; its first row reads "[customer C's name] (this customer)".
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Step 4:

  • Customer A's row and customer B's row are listed under the first row.
  • Customer A's name stays inside its own row: no part of it covers the row under it, and that row's text can be read.
  • Customer B's name stays inside its own row: no part of it covers the row under it, and that row's text can be read.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Open" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-03-after-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “First option: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)", then customers A to Z: "4 Star Truck Repair", "7 Star Truck Repair", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", "Aberdeen Diesel Services LLC" and on. Never Counter Sale.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
